mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (sku, name, brand, category_id, price, pack, stock) VALUES (#{sku}, #{name}, #{brand}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{pack}, #{stock})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET sku = #{sku}, name = #{name}, brand = #{brand}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, pack = #{pack}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sku) FROM product WHERE sku ~ '^SKU-[0-9]+$'
